name: Deep Sea Salvage
summary: Following Land Ho!, First Mate Nilzlix asks you to bring back the charts and logs of two sunken ships before anyone leaves the cove.

sections.title: Two Ships Lost in the Reef
sections.body: O'Breen led three ships into the cove, certain the treasure lay here. The Harbinger docked safely. Then, as the Maiden's Folly with the Spirit of Silverpine came in, the tides began to lower, and both ships ran aground on a temple-like structure in the reef and sank fast.

sections.title: What Nilzlix Wants Back
sections.body: Nilzlix wants the logs and the charts of both wrecked ships recovered, since that information must not be left behind for prying eyes. If it reached enemy hands, he says, Fleet Master Seahorn would force the crew down the plank.

faq.q: Why did the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine sink?
faq.answer: As the two ships came in, the tides began to lower. Both ran aground on something like a temple in the reef and sank quickly.
He is the first mate who speaks of the three ships O'Breen led into the cove, and he wants the logs and charts of the two sunken ones recovered.

faq.q: Why are the charts and logs so important?
faq.answer: Nilzlix does not want that information left behind for prying eyes. If enemies got hold of it, he says Fleet Master Seahorn would force the crew down the plank.

faq.q: What ship made it to safety?
faq.answer: Only the Harbinger. It docked safely in the cove, while the other two ships went down.
Nilzlix names him as the one who would force the crew down the plank if their records reached enemy hands.
